fields.description: Input hint in the chat composer, e.g. "Describe the script change…".

fields.label: Surface Type
fields.description: How the agent hands work over: Conversation = it only talks, nothing to apply. Document = offers a new version of something to accept or reject. Form = fills in fields to confirm. (Not the runner — that is Agent Framework.)

fields.label: Artifact Type
fields.description: What the thing it produces actually is — selects the preview renderer and the apply target (Script→editor, Diagram→canvas, Schema→builder, Record→form).
Leave empty to allow every logged-in user.
fields.label: Allowed Roles
Security
fields.description: Controls applied to this agent's traffic before it reaches a model provider.

Screens the user's message for Kuwait Civil IDs, contact details, passport and travel document numbers, and bank or payment details, replacing each with a token (e.g. [CIVIL_ID_1]) before the text reaches the model or the conversation log. Tokens are swapped back for the real value when the agent calls a tool, so lookups still work. Disable only for an agent whose work genuinely needs the raw values in the prompt — and record why.
fields.label: PII Input Screening
Evaluation
fields.description: Eval suites now link to this agent from the suite side — see the Evaluation group in the Connections panel above to view or add suites. (The former Evaluation Suite field was removed.)
Baseline evaluation cases are generated from these.
fields.label: Sample Prompts
Memory
fields.description: How this agent remembers. These settings are authoritative at dispatch — the BPMN shape no longer stores them; an older diagram's values are still honoured until the agent is configured here.

fields.label: Conversation Store
fields.description: Where this agent's message thread is kept. Process Variable lives in the instance and is discarded with it; Document Store persists. Blank inherits the diagram's value.

fields.label: Context Window (max messages)
fields.description: Most recent messages kept when priming a call; the system prompt is always retained. 0 inherits the diagram's value.

fields.label: Long-Term Memory
fields.description: Recall relevant saved memories before the call, and optionally save one after. Blank inherits the diagram's value.

fields.label: Memory Scope
fields.description: Agent — this task; Process — this process model; Entity — the task's context document.

fields.label: Memory Write Mode
fields.description: Distilled extracts durable, deduplicated facts; Raw stores the agent output verbatim (legacy); Off recalls only.

fields.label: Memory Models
fields.description: Which model does the memory writes. Falls back to the Processa Settings default, then to this agent's own AI Model — so leaving both blank keeps today's behaviour.

fields.label: Distillation Model
fields.description: Model that extracts durable facts from a run. A cheaper/faster model is usually fine here.

fields.label: Reconciliation Model
fields.description: Model that decides add / update / replace against existing memories. Raise this one when reconciliations are poor.
